property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that correctly accepts and returns from low-level calls, C.transfer always returns true when the call completes (does not revert); the mutant can return false immediately after the first successful external call, so there exist inputs (non-empty _tos and a callee that accepts the call) where the mutant returns false while the reference returns true.
change_summary: Return false immediately after the first successful call, changing observable return though calls may have been made.
